title: Acceptance Standard for Temporary For-Hire Permits on Wayfare Driver Agreements
content:
This acceptance standard of the **Driver Services Agreements and Account Standing** product sets the period for which a temporary for-hire permit is accepted.

## 1. Definition

The temporary permit acceptance days are the calendar days, counted from the day the driver uploads it, for which the temporary for-hire permit issued on renewal is accepted as the for-hire permit on file.

## 2. Effect of the upload

The upload puts the temporary permit on the standing record with an expiry date of the upload day plus the temporary permit acceptance days, and the for-hire permit expiry date on the agreement becomes that same date.

## 3. Length

3.1 The temporary permit acceptance days are 30 days.

3.2 The temporary permit acceptance days are never below one.

3.3 No rounding applies; the days are a whole number.

## 4. Worked example (hypothetical)

| Upload day | Temporary permit acceptance days | Expiry date on the standing record | For-hire permit expiry date on the agreement |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-09-05 | 30 | 2026-10-05 | 2026-10-05 |

Counting 30 calendar days from 2026-09-05 gives 25 days to the end of September and 5 in October, reaching 2026-10-05.
